people.name: Arnon

people.name: Heshbon
people.line: Amorite city conquered by Moses, allotted to Reuben

people.name: Moab

people.name: Sihon
people.line: Amorite king of Heshbon, defeated by the Israelites.

translations.web: For Heshbon was the city of Sihon the king of the Amorites, who had fought against the former king of Moab, and taken all his land out of his hand, even to the Arnon.
translations.bsb: Heshbon was the city of Sihon king of the Amorites, who had fought against the former king of Moab and taken all his land as far as the Arnon.
translations.kjv: For Heshbon was the city of Sihon the king of the Amorites, who had fought against the former king of Moab, and taken all his land out of his hand, even unto Arnon.
